notes.purpose: Sows due for mating, by pen; lens Open / Mated / All. A rail task: tap the row, no boxes.

elements.name: Task row
elements.shows: one sow (or litter): tag, one fact line, one memory line, rail

states.when: next mating can be given now
time since the last mating over the configured limit

elements.logic: Line 1 is words (state + when), line 2 is tokens (history, stamps). A chip appears only for an escalated measurement or a flagged observation; stamps appear on done rows and on rows that descend from a record. Everything on the row is derived; the worker types nothing here.

elements.name: Lens row
elements.shows: Open / Mated / All; funnel filters by mating count 0, 1, 2, 3, more than 3

elements.name: Unit KPI and Task overview
elements.shows: 1h heat to mating, target 12h or less; Task overview "32 mated · 14 to mate"
elements.logic: The KPI is the heat-to-mating interval; no formula is documented beyond its name and target.

rules: Breeding has no boxes and no bulk: scan opens the sow's sequence sheet directly.
issues: Pre-Astra look: rows, header and dock predate the Astra task skeleton.
Open question (research): is READY a window that expires? Today nothing escalates until the record is made.

notes.purpose: The sheet behind the Task overview cell for breeding: whole-task progress, KPI, configuration, SOP link and, where the task has one, End task. What failed the "does this change what a hand does at the pen right now?" test lives here, one tap from the room.

elements.name: End task
elements.rule: Breeding is an event task and closes itself record by record. The batch breeding phase close is a console action showing a derived split (mated once, twice, three or more stay; un-mated leave the batch), blocked until the heat check is closed (research delta 4). Whether the phone also needs a supervisor path is open (research).

elements.name: Configuration
elements.logic: Number of matings, interval limit (24 h in the research example), semen plan.

elements.name: Unit KPI
elements.shows: Heat to mating interval against its target.

issues: Pre-Astra look: header, KPI cells and sheet styling predate the Astra task skeleton.

notes.purpose: The sequence sheet for one sow: a timeline of matings with the current one ready to confirm.

elements.name: Interval warning
elements.shows: amber line when the interval since the last mating is over the limit
elements.rule: Shown only when over the configured limit; the row also carries the LAST chip. Dismissed by scrolling on.

elements.name: Semen batch
elements.logic: List comes from the console breeding plan. Default is the previous mating's batch; changing it at mating k forward-fills k+1 onward; always editable. The confirm button names the batch.

elements.name: Add mating
elements.shows: a done sow's sheet shows one ghost row to add the next mating
elements.rule: Extra matings continue the numbering and interval logic; no cap is documented.

edge: A sow found off the happy path (not in this unit, not in the batch, not marked in heat) goes through a guard sheet; a not-in-heat sow asks to confirm in heat and writes the heat record with attribution (research delta 3). That guard sheet is not drawn in the earlier deck.

notes.purpose: The unit as a map: is there work here, how much, how urgent. Tap lands in the pen; it never acts.

elements.name: Pen cell
elements.shows: pen code and at most one chip. For breeding, green READY chips mark pens with sows to mate now; done pens read, for example, "6 mated".

states.when: signs, due today, long interval, needs check

states.shows: tick beside the code, outcome in muted text

states.when: no pigs of this task in the pen

elements.logic: Priority is fixed: red, amber, green, neutral, done, grey; one chip per cell, most urgent wins. Counts lead the word and appear only from 2. The picker never inherits the lens or filter: every pen shows its real state.
elements.rule: Tap = land (header pinned). Long-press shows the peek. The grid never acts.

notes.purpose: The filter: mating time plus mating count, two groups.

elements.name: Dimensions kept
elements.logic: Heat status and pen row are dropped (lens, Go to pen). Mating count 0, 1, 2, 3, more than 3 stays and is breeding-only.

notes.purpose: Long-press a pen cell: one line per sow, the mating number and its one relevant fact.

elements.name: Peek card
elements.rule: Read-only. Ready sows carry the chip, waiting sows dim, done sows show a tick. It answers which sows are ready before walking in.

notes.purpose: Six cases of a searched pig by heat, batch and unit membership (A–F), with the end-task failure (某栏位猪只列表, 结束任务失败).
End the task with a second confirmation (结束任务, 二次确认).
Read-only list, task detail and mating detail after the task ends (配种详情, Tab：任务详情).
